sem_cobertura.mensagem: context and cancellation: NOT COVERED in Eff, Little and Spec; the release notes only bring isolated news (WithCancelCause, RN1.20 p.8; WithoutCancel and AfterFunc, RN1.21 p.7).
sync.WaitGroup and errgroup: NOT COVERED in any of the four sources.
Tests: NOT COVERED in Eff, Little and Spec; the release notes cite only isolated news (go test -skip in 1.20, RN1.20 p.3; testing.B.Loop in 1.24, RN1.24 p.4-5).
Doc comment conventions: NOT COVERED; Effective Go refers to 'Go Doc Comments', which is not in the sources (Eff p.3).
Go 1.25 and 1.26: NO release notes in the sources (only isolated marks: new(expr) = 1.26 in Eff p.15; future notices in RN1.24).
log/slog, slices and maps APIs from 1.21: only announced in RN1.21 p.6, without API detail; API NOT COVERED.
'Accept interfaces, return structs' is NOT in any source (only 'accept narrow interfaces', Little p.58-59); if you recommend it, label it [inference].
Analysis tools (race detector, vet, linters): usage NOT COVERED; the RN cite only new vet findings per version and the race detector rewrite on macOS (RN1.20 p.4).
sync.Pool and sync/atomic: usage NOT COVERED (atomic is only mentioned in Little p.74, p.82 and as And/Or in 1.23).
cgo and reflection: usage NOT COVERED; only isolated changes in the release notes.
Third-party libraries and frameworks: out of scope and NOT COVERED.
Performance and profiling: NOT COVERED (only the net/http/pprof import, Eff p.38, and PGO in the RN).
